cover_prompt: Full-color illustration, warm cozy cottagecore aesthetic, premium book cover artwork. A charming rustic garden potting shed with weathered wooden walls and a green-painted stable door propped open. Inside the shed, shelves overflow with terracotta pots, seed packets, and trailing ivy. A worn potting bench sits in front with seedling trays, gardening gloves, and a vintage brass watering can. Outside, a stone path leads through a lush cottage garden with tall hollyhocks, foxgloves, and climbing roses. A wheelbarrow filled with freshly potted geraniums sits beside the shed. A fluffy tabby cat naps on a sunny patch near the doorstep. Warm golden afternoon light streams through the shed window. Background shows a gentle green hillside with a blue sky and soft clouds. Warm earthy color palette with greens, terracotta, soft pinks, and golden yellows. Nostalgic, inviting garden sanctuary feeling. NO text in the image.
